results.title: A markdown link in the shipped documentation that resolves to a 500
results.evidence: `tests/test_documentation_links.py` asks each absolute link for its status and fails only on 404 — the comment says 3xx means the route exists, which is right, and a 500 is treated the same way. A documentation set every one of whose targets raises would pass this crawler, and the reader following a link gets an error page rather than the page the documentation promised.
